phase: Phase 3: File playback in the AudioBus
summary: The final Phase 3 adversarial gate passes. Both Vitest runs and all five runtime scenarios pass. Two findings go to tech debt only. No current host exposes either finding.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] adversarial-testing: tech-debt. tests/apk3d/no-unpolyfilled-builtins.test.ts:22–29 and :62–66 miss calls in template interpolations and calls split across lines. Comment stripping also hides a call after a quoted URL. The current audio paths use none of these calls.

F2 [Nit] adversarial-testing: tech-debt. src/apk3d/audio/bus.ts:124–132 skips non-enumerable own keys during same-base remaps. Removing a non-enumerable own hasOwnProperty entry can leave its decoded file playable. No current caller uses a map with non-enumerable keys.
evidence: The audit starts at a414b40604bb6bc1cecc65605b7ae5e59789a541. The review covers T6k 0cc7b5c4 and T6l 1f45fcfe only.
The VM loads the exact pinned bus.ts, chibi.ts, and generated map before any audio call. Each deleted built-in is absent before module evaluation.

The runtime matrix removes Object.hasOwn, structuredClone, Array.prototype.at, and Array.prototype.findLastIndex one at a time, then all at once. Each case wires Chibi audio, fetches three exact files, plays three files and one synth tone, stops the file sources, and closes the context.
In each runtime case, a plain object and a null-prototype object accept an own enumerable hasOwnProperty key. The bus plays the new mapped take after the remap.
F1: The exact scanner reports all four direct call controls. A comment, a quoted string, and plain template text report zero hits as expected.
F1: The same scan reports zero hits for `copy: ${structuredClone(data)}` and for four parse-valid calls with line breaks inside the call expression.
F1: The same scan reports zero hits for `const note = "never see https://example.test"; structuredClone(data);`. The active call followed by a real line comment with 'never' still reports one hit.
The scanner reports a call on line 4 as line 2 after removing a multiline block comment. Plan T6j already records this line-number limitation.
F2: A null-prototype map owns a non-enumerable hasOwnProperty entry and loads tap.ogg. The next map has no such entry. After the remap, the old tap.ogg starts with one fetch total.
Late finding F1: tech-debt (The false negatives affect a test tool, not current game behavior.)
Late finding F2: tech-debt (Current hosts use the generated map with enumerable properties.)
The pinned source search finds 29 host wiring calls and only the Chibi helper supplying sound maps. No current source caller supplies a custom map.
The PM dispositions for the two TD-44 skip pins stay unchanged. TD-45 remains outside the audio-only audit.
The all-[~] fixture reports two incomplete tasks. The live scan reports the active built-in call before a real comment with the filter word.
The eight-file command exits 0 and reproduces the T6l plan result. The plan has no unqualified all-checks-pass phrase.
The separate structural check reports stale measure/generated/status.md on the pinned tree. No audit file change caused that drift.
